data.name: Cursed Hospital
data.detailed_description:
The hospital’s fluorescent lights flicker, casting eerie shadows down sterile corridors. Once a place of healing, it’s now a tomb haunted by a vengeful ghost. Nurses and doctors vanish, their screams echoing through abandoned wards. You, a lone investigator, step into this nightmare, armed only with a flashlight and your wits. Blood-stained gurneys and scattered medical charts hint at a gruesome mystery. The air grows colder as the ghost’s whispers taunt you, daring you to uncover its dark secret before it claims another soul.

Each room holds clues to the hospital’s tragic past—a surgeon’s betrayal, a patient’s untimely death. The ghost, a spectral figure with hollow eyes, stalks you through locked doors and shattered windows. Heart-pounding chases force you to hide in closets or under beds, listening as its footsteps draw near. You piece together journal entries and old photographs, revealing the ghost’s identity: a wronged patient seeking revenge. Every discovery brings you closer to the truth, but also to the ghost’s wrath, testing your courage.

To stop the killings, you must confront the ghost in the hospital’s deepest basement, where its pain began. Solving puzzles and evading traps, you perform a ritual to banish the spirit. The hospital groans as the ghost resists, its wails shaking the walls. Success means freeing the trapped souls and escaping alive; failure means joining them. In this chilling horror game, every choice matters—will you uncover the truth and end the terror, or become another victim of the hospital’s curse?

data.short_description: In a haunted hospital, a vengeful ghost kills nurses and doctors. As an investigator, uncover the truth behind the deaths through clues and puzzles. Evade the ghost’s wrath, confront it in a chilling ritual, and banish the spirit to end the terror—or become its next victim.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Core i3 8th Gen, AMD Athlon Gold
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel UHD Graphics, AMD Radeon Vega 3
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Core i5 12th Gen, AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060, AMD 6500XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes: Our game is a horror experience featuring blood, non-realistic depictions of death (such as screams and blood on the floor), and ghostly apparitions. These elements are intended to create a spooky atmosphere but may not be suitable for all audiences. There are no depictions of sexual acts, sexual assault, non-consensual sex, drug or alcohol abuse, or self-harm. Players sensitive to intense or eerie themes should be aware.
